extracted.summary: NSP Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students, Assam provides financial support to OBC students in Assam studying from class 11 onwards.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual parent or guardian income of not more than INR 2,50,000 from all sources.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) community.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be studying in classes 11 or above in a recognised institution.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be domiciled in Assam.
